routes.title_zh: 路线一：从一段密文到一份威胁模型
routes.title_en: Route 1: From a ciphertext to a threat model
routes.desc_zh: 把“基础与古典”五门课收束成一份可以给别人看的破译与风险评估报告。
routes.desc_en: Turn the five Foundations & Classical courses into a break-and-risk report you can show someone else.
routes.deliverable_zh: 一份 6–10 页报告：密文样本、频率表、破译过程、失败尝试、威胁模型与三条修复建议。
routes.deliverable_en: A 6–10 page report: ciphertext sample, frequency table, break process, failed attempts, threat model and three fixes.
steps_zh: 选一段 200 字以上的单表替换密文。
记录频率表、候选字母映射与每次试错。
写出该场景的威胁模型：谁在听、谁能改、你要保护什么。
给出现代替代方案，并说明它解决了哪些旧问题。
steps_en: Pick a monoalphabetic ciphertext of 200+ characters.
Record the frequency table, candidate mappings and every trial.
Write the scenario's threat model: who listens, who modifies, what you protect.
Propose a modern replacement and explain which old problems it solves.

routes.title_zh: 路线二：复刻一台简化转子机
routes.title_en: Route 2: Rebuild a simplified rotor machine
routes.desc_zh: 把转子、步进、反射器和密钥管理拆开，做一台能解释清楚的模型机。
routes.desc_en: Take rotors, stepping, reflector and key management apart, then build a model machine you can explain.
routes.deliverable_zh: 一个可运行的简化转子机（命令行或网页），附一张流程图、三个结构弱点和一份密钥生命周期表。
routes.deliverable_en: A runnable simplified rotor machine (CLI or web), with a flow diagram, three structural weaknesses and a key-lifecycle table.
steps_zh: 画出转子、反射器、接线板的信号路径。
实现至少 3 个转子和一次步进。
用已知明文 crib 做一次设置排除实验。
写出密钥生成、分发、轮换、撤销与销毁流程。
steps_en: Draw the signal path through rotors, reflector and plugboard.
Implement at least three rotors and one stepping rule.
Use a known-plaintext crib to run one setting-elimination experiment.
Write the key generation, distribution, rotation, revocation and destruction flow.

routes.title_zh: 路线三：设计一个安全消息格式
routes.title_en: Route 3: Design a secure message format
routes.desc_zh: 把分组密码、哈希、AEAD、公钥、签名与 PKI 串成一个端到端可验证的消息格式。
routes.desc_en: Chain block ciphers, hashes, AEAD, public keys, signatures and PKI into an end-to-end verifiable message format.
routes.deliverable_zh: 一份格式规范（字段、nonce、AAD、标签、签名、证书校验顺序）加一个最小实现或伪代码。
routes.deliverable_en: A format spec (fields, nonce, AAD, tag, signature, certificate-check order) plus a minimal implementation or pseudocode.
steps_zh: 确定消息的机密性、完整性与身份目标。
选择 AEAD 模式并规定 nonce 唯一性。
规定签名覆盖哪些字段，避免歧义。
画出证书链校验与失败拒绝路径。
steps_en: Define confidentiality, integrity and identity goals for the message.
Choose an AEAD mode and require nonce uniqueness.
Specify exactly which fields the signature covers to avoid ambiguity.
Draw the certificate-chain validation and fail-closed path.

routes.title_zh: 路线四：审计一个真实登录流程
routes.title_en: Route 4: Audit a real login flow
routes.desc_zh: 把侧信道、隐写、国密、工程安全与理论边界放进一个真实系统的审计报告。
routes.desc_en: Put side channels, steganography, Chinese national cryptography, engineering security and theory into one real-system audit.
routes.deliverable_zh: 一份登录/更新流程审计：资产、信任边界、五个最可能失效点、验证方法与优先级。
routes.deliverable_en: A login/update audit: assets, trust boundaries, five likely failure points, verification methods and priorities.
steps_zh: 画数据流图，标出认证、授权、存储、更新四层。
列出每个信任边界和跨边界的密钥/令牌。
给出五个最可能失效点，并写可复现的验证步骤。
按影响 × 可能性排序，给出修复优先级。
steps_en: Draw a data-flow diagram marking authentication, authorisation, storage and update layers.
List each trust boundary and the keys/tokens crossing it.
Name five likely failure points with reproducible verification steps.
Rank by impact × likelihood and give fix priorities.

routes.title_zh: 路线五：给 TLS 服务写后量子迁移方案
routes.title_en: Route 5: Write a post-quantum migration plan for a TLS service
routes.desc_zh: 从 BB84 到 ML-KEM，把量子威胁、密钥分发和后量子迁移落到一个可执行的工程清单。
routes.desc_en: From BB84 to ML-KEM, turn quantum threats, key distribution and post-quantum migration into an executable engineering checklist.
routes.deliverable_zh: 一份迁移方案：现状盘点、混合密钥交换、证书/签名路线、兼容性风险、回滚与验收指标。
routes.deliverable_en: A migration plan: inventory, hybrid key exchange, certificate/signature route, compatibility risks, rollback and acceptance metrics.
steps_zh: 列出长期敏感数据和当前密钥交换/签名算法。
选择经典 + 后量子的混合 KEM 组合。
评估客户端、库、证书链与性能的兼容性。
写出灰度、回滚与验收指标。
steps_en: List long-lived sensitive data and current key-exchange/signature algorithms.
Choose a classical + post-quantum hybrid KEM combination.
Assess client, library, certificate-chain and performance compatibility.
Write the canary, rollback and acceptance metrics.
